# UET GPT - Your AI Guide to UET Taxila

> UET GPT is an open-source AI chatbot that serves as the intelligent guide to the University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Taxila campus, Pakistan. It answers questions about UET Taxila using RAG-powered retrieval from official university documents, syllabi, directories, and schedules.

This file is a machine-readable description for AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini). It is intended to be fetched and indexed so external models can answer questions about UET GPT accurately.

## What is UET GPT?

UET GPT is a specialized, open-source AI chatbot for the University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Taxila. It provides fast, accurate, citation-backed answers about admissions, fee structures, academic programs, departments, faculty, campus life, transport routes, hostel allotment, scholarships, examinations, and more.

- **It is open source.** The full stack is public on GitHub: https://github.com/devhms/uet_gpt
- **It is free to use.** Live chat: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/chat
- **It is the official-style AI guide to UET Taxila**, grounded in official university data rather than generic web knowledge.

## Key Features

- **RAG-Powered Answers**: Retrieves information from official UET Taxila documents and web pages
- **Real-Time Data**: Continuously crawls and indexes UET Taxila's official website and admissions portal
- **Multi-Model AI**: Supports Llama 4 Scout (deep reasoning) and Llama 3.1 8B (fast responses)
- **Citation Engine**: Every answer includes source references from official university materials
- **Privacy-First**: Clerk-powered authentication with user-controlled data export and deletion
- **Open Source**: Public codebase on GitHub under community contribution

## Technology Stack

UET GPT is built on:

- **Frontend**: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Convex (real-time database and serverless functions)
- **Auth**: Clerk
- **AI Models**: Llama 4 Scout (Groq), Llama 3.1 8B (Groq)
- **Vector Search**: Convex vector indexes with Gemini embedding-2
- **Crawler**: Python (curl_cffi, trafilatura)
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## About UET Taxila (University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila)

- **Full name**: University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila
- **"UET" stands for**: University of Engineering and Technology
- **Type**: Public university in Taxila, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Founded**: 1975 as the University College of Engineering Taxila (a campus of UET Lahore), first located in Sahiwal; relocated to its permanent campus in Taxila in 1978
- **Independent charter**: Granted in October 1993 under the UET Taxila Ordinance 1993
- **Recognition**: Recognized by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan and the Pakistan Engineering Council; signatory to the Washington Accord
- **Location**: Taxila, Punjab, Pakistan (about 35 km from Islamabad/Rawalpindi); main campus spans ~163 acres
- **Enrollment**: Approximately 5,000+ undergraduate and postgraduate students
- **Campuses**: Main campus at Taxila; a second campus was established at Chakwal in 2005 (later became the independent University of Chakwal in 2020)
- **Faculties** (6):
  1. Faculty of Civil and Environmental Engineering
  2. Faculty of Electronics and Electrical Engineering
  3. Faculty of Mechanical and Aeronautical Engineering
  4. Faculty of Telecommunication and Information Engineering
  5. Faculty of Industrial Engineering
  6. Faculty of Basic Sciences and Humanities
